tang_truong.mo_ta: Focus on new sales channels, higher output and new partnerships.

ky_ket.mo_ta: Focus on major contract talks, alliances and closing terms.

giu_tien.mo_ta: Focus on cost control, collecting receivables and tidier processes.

ra_mat.mo_ta: Focus on launch dates, new locations and marketing.

thang_ca_nhan.6: Care — keep clients and team close
thang_ca_nhan.7: Review — look back at the numbers

day_manh.tang_truong: Several readings agree: a good window to push sales targets, open channels and give the team clear goals.
day_manh.ky_ket: Several readings agree: a good window to negotiate terms, meet key partners and sign.
day_manh.giu_tien: Several readings agree: use the momentum to collect receivables and renegotiate costs.
day_manh.ra_mat: Several readings agree: a good window to lock launch dates and push the opening campaign.

can_bang._: An even month: carry out the agreed plan steadily, track results weekly and adjust lightly.

phong_thu._: A month to slow down a step: protect cashflow, review running contracts, tidy processes and look after existing clients.

chu_y.day_manh: Good momentum invites too many projects at once; cap the budget and name one owner before spending.
chu_y.can_bang: Avoid spreading people and money over side experiments; keep short cross-team check-ins to spot bottlenecks early.
chu_y.phong_thu: Avoid long fixed-cost commitments or rushed decisions without numbers; if a signing cannot wait, use a good date this month and read the exit clauses.

cap.giam_doc: Re-align department targets with leadership in the first half of the month.
cap.truong_nhom: Track progress weekly with your direct team.
